units.literal: Chen Lanxisi, in the Boluo mountains, gathered a crowd into the Tiandihui; prefect Yi Bingshou asked to send troops to capture him, but Jiqing, misled by Provincial Commander Sun Quanmou, did not permit it.

units.zh: 七年，陳爛屐四果剽掠作亂，擾及數縣，遣師擒斬之。
units.en: In the seventh year Chen Lanxisi did raid and rebel, troubling several counties. Jiqing sent troops who captured and executed him.
units.literal: In the seventh year Chen Lanxisi indeed plundered and rebelled, disturbing several counties; troops were sent and he was captured and executed.

units.zh: 餘黨曾鬼六复勾結永安諸賊相繼起，吉慶馳往剿捕，請調江西兵二千為助。
units.en: Remnant leader Zeng Guiliu then joined Yong'an bandits in a new uprising. Jiqing rushed to suppress them and asked for two thousand troops from Jiangxi.
units.literal: Remnant follower Zeng Guiliu again colluded with various bandits of Yong'an, who rose in succession; Jiqing rushed to suppress them and asked that two thousand Jiangxi troops be transferred to assist.

units.zh: 事聞，帝以吉慶奏報前後不符，措置失當，罷協辦大學士，留總督任，命那彥成往按。
units.en: When the reports arrived, the emperor found Jiqing's accounts inconsistent and his handling inept. He stripped him of the associate grand secretary post but kept him as governor and sent Nayancheng to investigate.
units.literal: When the matter was reported, the emperor, because Jiqing's memorials before and after did not agree and his arrangements were improper, removed him as associate grand secretary but retained him as governor, and ordered Nayancheng to go investigate.

units.zh: 吉慶復奏永安降匪多，請留兵防範，詔斥《頁》結局，解任聽勘。
units.en: Jiqing then reported many surrendered bandits in Yong'an and asked to keep troops on guard. The emperor rebuked him for trying to wrap the affair up carelessly, removed him from office, and ordered him to await trial.
units.literal: Jiqing again memorialized that there were many surrendered bandits in Yong'an and asked to retain troops for defense; an edict rebuked his careless conclusion to the affair, relieved him of duty, and ordered him to await investigation.

units.zh: 吉慶恚曰：「某雖不肖，曾備位政府，不可受辱傷國體！」
units.en: Jiqing said in anger: "I may be unworthy, but I once served in the central government. I cannot endure insult that shames the state!"
units.literal: Jiqing angrily said: "Though I am unworthy, I once held office in the central government; I cannot accept insult that wounds the dignity of the state!"

units.zh: 帝聞，命那彥成陳狀，尋以吉慶素廉潔，治匪有功，無故輕生，詔免追論。
units.en: On hearing this, the emperor ordered Nayancheng to report the facts. Remembering Jiqing's integrity and his success against bandits, and that he had killed himself without due cause, the emperor decreed that no further charges be pursued.
units.literal: When the emperor heard, he ordered Nayancheng to report the facts; shortly afterward, because Jiqing had always been incorrupt, had merit in suppressing bandits, and had taken his life without cause, an edict exempted further prosecution.

units.zh: 五十六年，出為山東巡撫，歲祲，截留漕米三十萬石，撥豫、東軍船運米賑饑。
units.en: In the fifty-sixth year he became governor of Shandong. During famine he retained 300,000 piculs of transport grain and used military grain boats from Henan and Shandong to ship rice for relief.
units.literal: In the fifty-sixth year he went out as governor of Shandong; the year was famine-stricken, and he retained three hundred thousand piculs of transport grain and allocated military grain boats from Henan and Shandong to carry rice for famine relief.

units.zh: 嘉慶元年，擢兩廣總督，劾水師提督路超吉不勝任，貶超吉秩。
units.en: In Jiaqing 1 he became governor-general of the Two Guangs, impeached Naval Commander Lu Chaoji as incompetent, and reduced his rank.
units.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he was promoted to governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi, impeached naval commander Lu Chaoji as incompetent, and reduced Chaoji's rank.

units.zh: 六年，命協辦大學士、總督如故。
units.en: In the sixth year he was made associate grand secretary while retaining the governorship.
units.literal: In the sixth year he was ordered to serve as associate grand secretary while remaining governor as before.

units.zh: 命赴山東、湖南、湖北、河南讞獄，均稱旨，調戶部。
units.en: Sent to try criminal cases in Shandong, Hunan, Hubei, and Henan, he pleased the emperor in each province and was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
units.literal: Ordered to go to Shandong, Hunan, Hubei, and Henan to try criminal cases, in each case he met with imperial approval and was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

units.zh: 兼署提督，獲海盜陳言等，及臨海邪匪李鶴皋，置之法。
units.en: As acting provincial military commander he captured pirates including Chen Yan and the sect rebel Li Hegao of Linhai and executed them.
units.literal: Acting concurrently as provincial military commander, he captured pirates including Chen Yan and the heterodox bandit Li Hegao of Linhai, and punished them by law.

units.zh: 二年，廣西西隆亞稿寨苗匪句結貴州仲苗，竄踞八渡，率提督彭承堯進剿，克其要隘。
units.en: In the second year Miao rebels from Yagao stockade in Guangxi's Xilong colluded with Guizhou's Zhong Miao, seized Badu, and he led Provincial Commander Peng Chengyao to take their key passes.
units.literal: In the second year, Miao bandits of Yagao stockade in Xilong, Guangxi, colluded with Zhong Miao of Guizhou, fled to occupy Badu, and he led Provincial Commander Peng Chengyao forward to suppress them and captured their strategic passes.

units.zh: 父萬福，騎都尉，官江寧將軍，兼散秩大臣。
units.en: His father Wanfu was a commandant of cavalry who served as Jiangning general and as a minister without regular portfolio.
units.literal: His father Wanfu held the rank of commandant of cavalry, served as Jiangning general, and was concurrently a minister without regular portfolio.

units.zh: 乾隆五十年，嗣世職。
units.en: In Qianlong 50 he inherited his family's hereditary office.
units.literal: In the fiftieth year of Qianlong he inherited the hereditary office.

units.zh: 擢鑲白旗蒙古副都統，累遷兵部侍郎。
units.en: He was promoted to vice commander of the Bordered White Mongol Banner and eventually became vice minister of War.
units.literal: He was promoted to vice commander of the Bordered White Mongol Banner and rose repeatedly to vice minister of War.

units.zh: 鹽政岳謙執拗病民，劾罷之，遂兼鹽政。
units.en: He impeached and removed Salt Controller Yue Qian for obstinacy that harmed the people, then took over the salt post himself.
units.literal: Salt controller Yue Qian was obstinate and harmed the people; he impeached and removed him, then concurrently held the salt post.

units.zh: 黔苗潛渡百樂窺泗城，令副將德昌等分路攻撲，毀苗砦十有九；
units.en: When Guizhou Miao secretly crossed at Baile toward Sicheng, he sent Vice Commander Dechang and others along separate routes and destroyed nineteen Miao stockades.
units.literal: Guizhou Miao secretly crossed at Baile intending to spy on Sicheng; he ordered vice commanders including Dechang to attack by separate routes and destroyed nineteen Miao stockades;

units.zh: 進攻亞稿，至戛雄遇賊，大敗之。
units.en: Advancing on Yagao, he met the rebels at Gaxiong and routed them.
units.literal: Advancing against Yagao, at Gaxiong he met the rebels and inflicted a great defeat.

units.zh: 亞稿山路陡峻，選精卒由間道潛襲，克其巢，斬首千級，以功加太子太保，賜雙眼花翎。
units.en: Yagao's mountain roads were steep. He sent picked troops along a hidden path, took the rebel stronghold, and took a thousand heads. For this he was made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.
units.literal: The mountain roads of Yagao were steep; he chose elite troops to strike secretly by a bypath, captured their lair, and beheaded a thousand; for this merit he was made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.

units.zh: 亞稿之捷，投誠者十餘寨，惟附近那地、小河、廣平、蒙裡等寨猶恃險抗拒，會雲南兵至，會剿，盡克之。
units.en: After the victory at Yagao more than ten stockades submitted, but Nadu, Xiaohe, Guangping, Mengli, and nearby stockades still held out. Yunnan troops arrived, they joined the campaign, and took them all.
units.literal: After the victory at Yagao, more than ten stockades submitted, but nearby Nadu, Xiaohe, Guangping, Mengli, and other stockades still relied on terrain to resist; when Yunnan troops arrived they joined in suppression and captured them all.

units.zh: 賊首龍登連父子乞降，粵境悉平。
units.en: Rebel leaders Long Denglian and his son surrendered, and the Guangdong frontier was fully pacified.
units.literal: Bandit leaders Long Denglian, father and son, begged to surrender, and the Guangdong border was entirely pacified.

units.zh: 又通省贓罰銀按縣派徵，為臬司漏規。
units.en: Provincial fines in silver were also apportioned by county as an illegal levy for the surveillance commissioner.
units.literal: furthermore, throughout the province fines in silver were levied by county apportionment as a leak in regulations for the provincial surveillance commissioner.

units.zh: 事並上聞，詔斥其因循。
units.en: When both matters reached the throne, an edict rebuked his indulgence and delay.
units.literal: When both matters were reported upward, an edict rebuked his indulgence and delay.

units.zh: 詔斥其張皇，始疑之。
units.en: An edict rebuked his alarmism, and the emperor began to doubt him.
units.literal: An edict rebuked his alarmism, and the emperor began to doubt him.

units.zh: 尋敗賊於義容墟，曾清浩率眾四千餘人繳械降。
units.en: He soon defeated the rebels at Yirongxu, and Zeng Qinghao surrendered with more than four thousand men and their arms.
units.literal: Shortly afterward he defeated the bandits at Yirongxu; Zeng Qinghao led more than four thousand men to surrender their weapons.

units.zh: 巡撫瑚圖禮素與有隙，既奉密諭诇察，遂疏劾其疲輭不職，那彥成猶未至，獨鞫之，據高坐，設囚具，隸卒故加訶辱。
units.en: Governor Hutuli, who had long been his enemy, received a secret order to investigate and impeached him as slack and incompetent. Before Nayancheng arrived, Hutuli tried him alone from a high seat with shackles set out, while attendants deliberately insulted him.
units.literal: Governor Hutuli had long been at odds with him; having received a secret edict to spy, he memorialized impeaching him as slack and incompetent; before Nayancheng arrived he alone tried him, sat on a high seat, set out prisoner implements, and clerks and runners deliberately added abuse and insult.

units.zh: 因自戕。
units.en: He then took his own life.
units.literal: and thereupon killed himself.

units.zh: 子壽喜，仍襲世職，坐事黜，以弟常喜嗣。
units.en: His son Shouxi inherited the hereditary office but was dismissed for an offense; his younger brother Changxi succeeded instead.
units.literal: His son Shouxi still inherited the hereditary office, was dismissed for an offense, and his younger brother Changxi succeeded.

units.zh: 又擊硃濆、烏石二於宮仔洋，從李長庚追敗之於閩、粵交界甲子洋。
units.en: again attacked Zhu Fen and Wushi Er at Gongzai Sea, and under Li Changgeng pursued and routed them at Jiazi Sea on the Fujian-Guangdong border.
units.literal: again attacked Zhu Fen and Wushi Er at Gongzai Sea, and following Li Changgeng pursued and defeated them at Jiazi Sea on the Fujian-Guangdong border.

units.zh: 十三年，追剿烏石二於丫洲洋，擊沉數艘，賊艦續至益多。
units.en: In the thirteenth year he pursued Wushi Er to Yazhou Bay, sank several junks, but pirate ships kept arriving in ever greater numbers.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year he pursued and suppressed Wushi Er at Yazhou Sea, sank several vessels, but bandit ships continued arriving in ever greater numbers.

units.zh: 嘉慶十年，護理金門鎮總兵。
units.en: In the tenth year of Jiaqing he served as acting regional commander of the Jinmen garrison.
units.literal: In the tenth year of Jiaqing he acted as regional commander of Jinmen Town.

units.zh: 韓鼎晉正月戊戌左副都御史。
units.en: On the wuxu day of the first month, 韓鼎晉: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the wuxu day of the first month, 韓鼎晉: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 韓鼎晉
units.en: 韓鼎晉.
units.literal: 韓鼎晉.

units.zh: 嘉慶二十四年己卯
units.en: Twenty-fourth year of Jiaqing, 1819, jimao
units.literal: Twenty-fourth year of Jiaqing, jimao

units.zh: 嘉慶二十五年庚辰
units.en: Twenty-fifth year of Jiaqing, 1820, gengchen
units.literal: Twenty-fifth year of Jiaqing, gengchen

units.zh: 十三年，宗室敏學恃勢不法，讞擬輕比，詔斥部臣屈法縱姦，譴責有差。
units.en: In 1808 the imperial clansman Min Xue abused his status and broke the law, yet the ministry proposed a lenient sentence. The throne rebuked the officials for bending the law to protect him, and punished them in varying degrees.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year the imperial clansman Min Xue relied on his status and acted unlawfully; the proposed judgment used a lenient analogy. An edict rebuked the ministry officials for bending the law to indulge wrongdoing, and rebukes were assigned in varying degrees.

units.zh: 令總兵魏大斌赴援，戰賊失利，又令游擊田藍玉援大斌。
units.en: He sent commander Wei Dabin to relieve the city, but Dabin was beaten in action; he then ordered guerrilla commander Tian Lanyu to reinforce him.
units.literal: He ordered Commander-in-chief Wei Dabin to go to the relief; in fighting the rebels he was defeated, and he then ordered Guerrilla Commander Tian Lanyu to reinforce Dabin.

units.zh: 初，命總督溫承惠往剿，清既誅，乃發京兵，授那彥成欽差大臣，加都統銜，督師率楊遇春、楊芳等討之，迭詔責戰甚急。
units.en: At first Governor-General Wen Chenghui was ordered to suppress them; after Lin Qing was killed, capital troops were sent out, Na Yancheng was made Imperial Commissioner with commandant rank to direct Yang Yuchun, Yang Fang, and others, and repeated edicts urgently pressed for action.
units.literal: At first Governor-General Wen Chenghui was ordered to suppress them; after Lin was executed, capital troops were dispatched, Na Yancheng was made Imperial Commissioner with commandant rank, directed the armies with Yang Yuchun, Yang Fang, and others to attack, and repeated edicts urgently pressed for battle.

units.zh: 蔣予蒲五月戊申遷。七月庚寅李宗瀚左副都御史。
units.en: On the wushen day of the fifth month, 蔣予蒲 was transferred. On the gengyin day of the seventh month, 李宗瀚: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: On the wushen day of the fifth month, 蔣予蒲 was transferred. On the gengyin day of the seventh month, 李宗瀚: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 李宗瀚憂免。四月丙子蔣祥墀左副都御史。
units.en: 李宗瀚 was relieved due to mourning. On the bingzi day of the fourth month, 蔣祥墀: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: 李宗瀚 was relieved due to mourning. On the bingzi day of the fourth month, 蔣祥墀: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 嘉慶十九年甲戌
units.en: Nineteenth year of Jiaqing, 1814, jiaxu
units.literal: Nineteenth year of Jiaqing, jiaxu

units.zh: 嘉慶二十年乙亥
units.en: Twentieth year of Jiaqing, 1815, yihai
units.literal: Twentieth year of Jiaqing, yihai

units.zh: 洪亮吉管世銘谷際岐李仲昭石承藻
units.en: Hong Liangji, Guan Shiming, Gu Jiqi, Li Zhongzhao, and Shi Chengzao
